subject: environmental-science
title: UK Nature: Woodlands & Hedgerows
welcome_lead: Step into a British wood — full of birds, bugs and old trees.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: UK woodlands, oak, hedgerows.
final_note: Even small bits of woodland support hundreds of species.

concepts.def: Long-lived UK tree home to 2000+ species.
Red or grey rodent climbing trees.
Night bird that hunts mice and voles.

walkthroughs.body_html: An oak tree can live over 1000 years and support more than 2000 species of insect, bird, fungus and mammal — a tower block for nature.
In spring, ancient woods fill with bluebells. The UK has half the world's bluebells — they're a sign of an old wood.
Hedgerows are wildlife motorways. Birds, insects and small mammals move along them between woods and fields.
